what_it_does: This paper describes a single chip that sends and receives cellular signals (a transceiver) for IoT devices on LTE Cat1bis networks. The key innovation is using harmonic rejection—a technique that cancels out unwanted signal copies—on the transmit side and a clever receiver design that avoids generating spurious signals, so the chip doesn't need as many bulky external filters. By designing the chip at 28 nanometers and integrating multiple frequency bands on the same silicon, they keep the total size, packaging, and cost low for manufacturers.
